headline: Approved $17,203.20 employee assistance contract; $191,616 Branching Minds platform continued to the next agenda.
summary: The committee covered school improvement plans, the FY25 audit, and absentee data for support staff. It approved the Growing Friendship agreement and first passage of a template contract for principals and assistant principals. It continued the Branching Minds contract to a later agenda.
decisions: Approved the Growing Friendship agreement with The Empowerment Factory, 7 to 0 on roll call.
Approved the 26-27 virtual instructional day plan, to be sent to RIDE for final review, by roll call vote.
Continued the Branching Minds MTSS platform contract to the next agenda.
Approved the C3 Wellbeing employee assistance (EAP) contract at $17,203.20, 6 to 0.
Approved first passage of the template administrator contract for principals and assistant principals, 6 to 0.
Approved first passage of revised policy BEDB on the school committee calendar and agenda, 6 to 0.
discussion: Support staff absences: Members questioned how absences were counted, asked for a comparison across years, and raised paid and unpaid leave codes that the contract had removed.
TA training: Members asked for a longer orientation, more time in classrooms, and attention to student IEPs, and raised TA vacancies and recruiting.
Student absentee reporting: Staff explained a new state rule that counts instructional minutes and Skyward reporting delays that required manual fixes.
Branching Minds contract: Members asked whether other Rhode Island districts used the platform and whether references had been checked.
Administrator contract: Members discussed principals' questions about the template and the November 2 meeting for a second passage.
